records.name: Angular UDialog
records.purpose: Modal or non-modal dialog shell: a controlled visible input renders a mask and panel with optional header, projected content and a [dialogFooter] slot, and reports close requests through visibleChange.
records.surface: Selector u-dialog; componentName dialog; extends UBaseComponent. Inputs: visible (false), header, closable (true), closeOnEscape (true), modal (true) and role ('dialog' or 'alertdialog', default 'dialog'). Outputs: visibleChange (boolean), onShow and onHide. Injects ComponentIdGenerator without a default: the app must provide it (ng-core ComponentIdGenerator has no providedIn), otherwise construction throws NullInjectorError. The aria-labelledby id is `${next('u_dialog')}_header`. Template: while renderMask is true a mask div with uOverlay (appendTo body) wraps a root div carrying [attr.role], [attr.aria-modal]=modal() and aria-labelledby only when header is set; inside it a uFocusTrap div bound with [uFocusTrapDisabled]=!modal(). The header block, including the title span and the close button, is rendered only inside @if (header()), so with no header there is no close button even when closable is true. The footer div is always rendered and projects [dialogFooter]. visibleChange is the only close channel: close() and the Escape callback emit visibleChange(false); the component never sets visible itself, so the consumer controls it. There is no mask-click dismissal, and no drag, resize, maximize or position input. Visibility effect: on the server it only mirrors visible into renderMask. In the browser every run calls syncEscapeRegistration (displayOrderRegistry plus escapeRegistry.register with ESCAPE_PRIORITIES.DIALOG, whose callback emits visibleChange(false) only when closeOnEscape is true, so only the highest-ordered registered dialog receives Escape) and syncScrollLock (scroll lock: scrollLockRegistry.register while visible, unregister otherwise, with a Math.random id). On opening it records document.activeElement, sets renderMask and, after the next render, runs an enter motion (createMotion name u-dialog, onShow emitted when it resolves unless destroyed; onShow is emitted immediately when no root element exists). On closing it runs the leave motion (renderMask is cleared immediately when no motion instance exists, otherwise after it resolves unless destroyed), restores focus to the recorded element and emits onHide synchronously, before the leave motion finishes. The dialog does not move focus into itself when opened; focus entry is left to the content, and the focus trap only wraps Tab at the edges (ng-core, not read here beyond its call site). ngOnDestroy unregisters escape and display order if registered and always calls scrollLockRegistry.unregister; destroyRef.onDestroy only sets a destroyed flag. Style module: dialog-style.ts imports the CSS from @ultimate/uix-styles/dialog and exports DialogClassesParams ({modal?}) and dialogStyleModule; the classes object names resizeHandle (p-resizable-handle) and pcMaximizeButton that this template does not render. Entry points: re-exported by the root barrel packages/ng/src/index.ts only; there is no ./dialog manifest subpath and no packages/ng/dialog secondary entry-point directory. Metadata: DIALOG_METADATA exists in packages/component-metadata/src/records/dialog.ts with this component as its source path, and dialog.api.mdx is a generated page excluded from this record's files. Aura registry key: dialog.

records.name: Angular UDrawer
records.purpose: Edge-anchored panel: a controlled visible input renders a mask and a panel positioned left, right, top, bottom or full, with header, content and a [drawerFooter] slot.
records.surface: Selector u-drawer; componentName drawer; extends UBaseComponent. Inputs: visible (false), header, position ('left','right','top','bottom','full'; default 'left'), modal (true), dismissible (true), closable (true), closeOnEscape (true). Outputs: visibleChange, onShow, onHide. Does not inject ComponentIdGenerator. Template: a uOverlay mask (appendTo body) with mousedown and mouseup handlers around a root div with role=complementary and a keydown handler (onKeyDown); inside it a uFocusTrap div with no disabled binding, so the trap is on whether or not modal is set. The header div is always rendered, the title span only when header is set, and the close button only when closable is true. No aria-modal, aria-label or aria-labelledby is bound. applyVisible(visible) is driven by an effect on visible: opening sets renderMask, registers an escape callback (ESCAPE_PRIORITIES.SIDEBAR with a per-class instanceCount uid) and emits onShow synchronously; closing clears renderMask, unregisters and emits onHide. There is no motion, focus restore or scroll lock. The public close() emits visibleChange(false) and also calls applyVisible(false), so the drawer closes locally even if the parent keeps visible true. Escape has two paths, and both paths call close() when closeOnEscape is true: onKeyDown (only for keydown events dispatched inside the root div) and the document-level escapeRegistry callback. For a keydown inside the root div, onKeyDown runs before the document listener and close() synchronously unregisters the registry callback, so that keypress emits visibleChange(false) once; the registry path is reached only when the event target is outside the root div, and an open dialog or popover (higher priorities) takes the registry Escape first. Mask dismissal needs dismissible and modal both true and requires mousedown and mouseup to both target the mask element itself. ngOnDestroy only unregisters the escape callback. The instanceCount counter is private static to this class. Style module: drawer-style.ts keeps the CSS as a local string (selectors include .u-drawer > [ufocustrap] and .u-drawer-mask:dir(rtl)) and exports DrawerClassesParams ({position?}) and drawerStyleModule. Entry points: re-exported by the root barrel packages/ng/src/index.ts only; there is no ./drawer manifest subpath and no packages/ng/drawer secondary entry-point directory. No dedicated @ultimate/uix-styles export exists for this family, so its CSS is a local string in the style module and no uix-styles relationship is linked. There is no component-metadata record for this family, so no metadata relationship is linked. Aura registry key: drawer.

records.name: Angular UPopover
records.purpose: Imperatively shown floating panel: show(event, target?), toggle and hide position projected content under a target element and dismiss on outside click, window resize or Escape.
records.surface: Selector u-popover; componentName popover; extends UBaseComponent. Input: dismissable (true). Outputs: onShow, onHide. Public methods: toggle(event, target?), show(event, target?) and hide(). There is no visible input. show() calls event.stopPropagation(), takes target ?? event.currentTarget ?? event.target, sets visible and render, binds document click and window resize listeners, registers an escape callback (ESCAPE_PRIORITIES.OVERLAY_PANEL with a per-class instanceCount uid) that calls hide(), aligns after the next render and emits onShow synchronously. hide() returns immediately when not visible; otherwise it unbinds, unregisters and emits onHide. The document click listener returns at once when dismissable is false (the selfClick flag is then not reset); otherwise it hides when selfClick is false, the content does not contain the click target and the click is not on the target element or inside it, and then resets selfClick. Any window resize hides regardless of dismissable, and Escape hides regardless of dismissable. align() writes top = target.bottom + scrollY and left = target.left + scrollX on the uOverlay container (the content's parent element) and calls ZIndex.set('overlay', ..., 1000); there is no flip, arrow or viewport clamp. Template: a uOverlay div (appendTo body) with role=dialog and [attr.aria-modal]=visible(), so aria-modal is 'true' while shown although the panel is non-modal; it has no aria-label and no focus management. The overlay and content click handlers set selfClick. ngOnDestroy unbinds both listeners, unregisters the escape callback and calls ZIndex.clear on the container when it exists. The instanceCount counter is private static to this class, so UPopover and UConfirmPopup each start at 1: if a popover and a confirm popup with the same uid are both registered, escapeRegistry keeps one callback per (OVERLAY_PANEL, uid) key, so the later register replaces the earlier one and either component's unregister removes the entry. Style module: popover-style.ts holds a local CSS string and exports popoverStyleModule only (classes root and content); there is no ClassesParams export. Entry points: exported from the @ultimate/ng/popover manifest subpath and re-exported by the root barrel packages/ng/src/index.ts. No dedicated @ultimate/uix-styles export exists for this family, so its CSS is a local string in the style module and no uix-styles relationship is linked. There is no component-metadata record for this family, so no metadata relationship is linked. Aura registry key: popover.

records.name: Angular UTooltip
records.purpose: Attribute directive that shows a text tooltip bubble on hover or focus of its host element.
records.surface: A directive (selector [uTooltip]), not a component; componentName tooltip; extends UBaseComponent. Inputs: uTooltip (string), uTooltipPosition ('top','bottom','left','right'; default 'top') and uTooltipDisabled (boolean). No outputs. Host listeners: mouseenter and focus call show(); mouseleave and blur call hide(). Injects ComponentIdGenerator without a default: the app must provide it. show() runs in the browser only, does nothing without text or when disabled, removes any previous container, creates a div role=tooltip with id `${next('u_tooltip')}`, an arrow div and a text div and class u-tooltip-<position>, sets inline display inline-block, appends it to document.body, aligns, calls ZIndex.set('tooltip', ..., 1100) and appends its id to the host aria-describedby (keeping existing ids). hide() clears the z-index, removes only its own id from aria-describedby (removing the attribute when empty) and removes the container. records.purpose: Container that overlays a mask on its projected content (or the viewport) while blocked is true and reports blocked and unblocked transitions.
records.surface: Selector u-block-ui; componentName blockui (differs from the block-ui folder name); extends UBaseComponent.
